priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon, and Thunderstrike Ward buffs at all times.
Use Stormkeeper on cooldown, but avoid overlapping it with the start of Ascendance.
Cast Ascendance as your primary offensive cooldown, provided Stormkeeper is not immediately available.
Use Ancestral Swiftness and Trinkets/Potions alongside your major cooldowns.
Cast Voltaic Blaze (from Purging Flames/Surge of Power) to spread Flame Shock or when Master of Elements is down.
Cast Tempest if Master of Elements is active for maximum damage.
Cast Tempest immediately if you have 2 stacks available to prevent overcapping.
Cast Earthquake as your primary Maelstrom spender on 3 or more targets.
Cast Elemental Blast as a secondary Maelstrom spender (if talented), targeting enemies without Lightning Rod.
Cast Lava Burst if Voltaic Blaze is available or to consume Lava Surge procs when Master of Elements is needed.
Use Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning to rapidly generate Maelstrom.
Cast Chain Lightning as your primary filler and builder on 3 or more targets.
Use Flame Shock, Voltaic Blaze, or Frost Shock while moving if Spiritwalker's Grace is unavailable.
